en.title: Two fighter jets sold to Taiwan after US-China talks; Trump administration's Taiwan policy unchanged
en.summary: Two F-16V Block 70 fighter jets arrived in Taiwan on October 2, one week after US-China summit talks. The arms sale proceeded despite strong Chinese opposition.

en.title: Iran-aligned Houthis attack Saudi oil facilities for second consecutive day using ballistic missiles and drones
en.summary: Yemen-based Houthi militants claimed responsibility for attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital and eastern Saudi Aramco facilities on October 4, following similar operations the previous day. Both attacks allegedly used ballistic missiles and drones, causing fires.

en.title: Trump announces formal establishment of US AI command center named "Super Intelligence Force"
en.summary: US President Trump officially announced the creation of a government AI policy coordination command center on October 4. The organization will be called SI Force, named after the term "Super Intelligence" that Trump has promoted.

en.title: Horse racing: Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe; Japanese horses finish 11th and 14th without initial victory
en.summary: Two Japanese horses competed in the world's premier Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe horse race in France on October 4, finishing in 11th and 14th place respectively, failing to achieve a first-ever victory.

en.title: DeNA defeats Hanshin in extra-inning walk-off win in final game, advances to CS with fourth consecutive month above .500
en.summary: DeNA won 2-1 against Hanshin in extra innings on the fourth, securing their fourth consecutive month with a winning record and qualifying for the championship series.

en.title: Arc de Triomphe Horse Race: Japanese Competitors Fall Short of Historic First Victory
en.summary: The 105th Arc de Triomphe race held in Paris saw two Japanese-trained horses compete but failed to achieve a first-ever victory for Japan. Admire Terra finished 11th and Meisho Tabal placed 14th.
